build_study_loader: build a StudyLoader with a data path and optional query to load Algonauts2025 study timelines
load_base_data_events: load events from a BaseData timeline instance into a validated pandas DataFrame with subject and study columns
iterate_study_timelines: iterate over all Algonauts2025 timelines in a given data path using StudyLoader iter_timelines method
generate_study_summary: generate a study summary DataFrame with subject_index and timeline_index columns using StudyLoader study_summary method
apply_enhancers_to_events: apply a list of Enhancer functions to concatenated timeline events before validation using StudyLoader build method
